identificationModule.officialTitle: Real-World Patients With Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Treated With Mavacamten - a Single-Center Descriptive Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the real-world outcomes of individuals diagnosed with obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) treated with mavacamten at the Hospital of The University of Pennsylvania in the US

primaryOutcomes.measure: Participant New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional class
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline, and at weeks 4, 8, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72, 84, 96, and 108 weeks

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years at index date
* Prescription of mavacamten for the treatment of Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (oHCM)
* ≥ 4 weeks of follow-up after prescription of mavacamten

Exclusion Criteria:

* Data collection as part of a clinical trial during the study period
* Current participation in a myosin inhibitor clinical trial
eligibilityModule.studyPopulation: The study population will comprise of adult individuals diagnosed with Obstructive Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) that have been prescribed mavacamten at The Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania between April 1, 2022 and January 17, 2025
